name: Valverde de los Arroyos (Spain)
description: Green field with a white triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly, charged with two blue wavy stripes.
history: The arms of Valverde de los Arroyos were approved on 14 February 2006 and the flag on 30 October 2006; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, white with two blue wavy horizontal stripes, pierced with green.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex towards the fly
